title: Acquirer: Ericsson Australia Pty Ltd, Damovo (Australia) Pty Ltd; Target: Telstra Corporation Ltd
acquirers: Ericsson Australia Pty Ltd, Damovo (Australia) Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Damovo (formerly Ericsson Corporate Networks) acquires Telstra's PABX maintenance and service business.
body_sections.Market definition: The market appears to be appropriately defined as either that for the sales and maintenance of switched business telephony systems, or as that for PABX maintenance services
body_sections.Competition analysis: Some PABX maintenance service customers have technical expertise to carry out their own PABX maintenance. There are indications that convergence between traditional PABX technologies and computer based systems will open up competitive options for businesses seeking telephony systems and associated maintenance. Indications from the market suggest that there is little concern about any competitive effects of this merger.
